name: From Darkness, I Bind You
source:
Found as a baby within Saruman's tower, Tuilindil is adopted and raised in the 4th Age after Sauron's defeat. The curious elf grows close to Legolas, who comes to visit Minas Tirith. One day, Saruman's dark magic sends her back into the past as his prisoner. He assaults her mind to learn the events of the future. He sees Frodo carrying the one ring and he sends his crebain after him. The ring is brought to Rivendell but Frodo perishes. Gandalf helps Tuilindil escape the tower and Sam must now carry the ring. Because of her presence, a chain of events has begun unraveling the timeline and places all Middle-Earth in danger.  

Saruman's figure towered over Tuilindil, casting a long shadow that swallowed the room. "You will tell me," his voice a venomous hiss. "I will extract every morsel of information from you, one way or another!"  His eyes, once filled with a cold and calculated gaze, now burned with an unholy fire. Behind his taunting words and twisted smiles. She sensed the depths of his anger, directed at her for withholding the answers he sought.   With a cruel smile, Saruman raised both wizard staffs, a sinister intent shimmering in his eyes. As he made contact with Tuilindil's consciousness, she screamed, the pain ripping through her like a tempestuous storm. His mental assaults pierced through the fragile barriers she had erected.  She cried out, her voice a desperate plea for mercy, as her fragile mind and soul were laid bare before the relentless intrusion. Images, memories, and fragments of her consciousness spilled forth uncontrollably. Like shattered fragments of a mirror, reflecting the memories she held...  

 ... the secrets of the future.

[From [url=https://nightfable.itch.io/from-darkness-i-bind-you-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

This kinetic novel is based on the Lord of the Rings fanfic, [url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/10962868/1/From-Darkness-I-Bind-You]From Darkness, I Bind You[/url].
translation:
图伊林迪尔还是婴儿时就被发现在萨鲁曼的塔中，索伦被击败后在第四纪元被收养并抚养长大。好奇的精灵与前来拜访米那斯提力斯的莱戈拉斯越来越亲近。有一天，萨鲁曼的黑魔法将她送回过去，成为他的囚犯。他攻击她的思想以了解未来的事件。他看到弗罗多拿着一枚戒指，于是派他的克雷班追随他。戒指被带到瑞文戴尔，但佛罗多却死了。甘道夫帮助图林迪尔逃离塔楼，山姆现在必须携带戒指。由于她的存在，一系列事件开始瓦解时间线，并将整个中土世界置于危险之中。

萨茹曼的身影高耸于图林迪尔之上，投下一道长长的阴影，吞没了整个房间。“你会告诉我的，”他的声音充满了恶毒的嘶嘶声。“我会以某种方式从你身上获取每一点信息！”  原本冰冷而算计的目光，此刻却燃烧着邪恶的火焰。在他嘲讽的话语和扭曲的微笑背后。她感觉到他的愤怒之深，是针对她隐瞒了他所寻求的答案。萨鲁曼冷笑一声，举起了双根法杖，眼中闪烁着阴险之色。当他接触到图林迪尔的意识时，她尖叫起来，疼痛像暴风雨一样席卷了她。他的精神攻击刺穿了她筑起的脆弱屏障。她大声喊叫，她的声音绝望地恳求怜悯，因为她脆弱的心灵和灵魂在无情的入侵面前暴露无遗。图像、记忆、意识碎片不受控制地涌出。如同镜子破碎的碎片，映照出她的记忆……  

 …未来的秘密。

[来自[url=https://nightfable.itch.io/from-darkness-i-bind-you-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

这部动感小说改编自指环王同人小说，[url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/10962868/1/From-Darkness-I-Bind-You]来自黑暗，我束缚你[/url]。
